SELECT
        amsdal_schema_registry.table_name AS table_name,
        amsdal_schema_registry.name AS name,
        amsdal_schema_registry.version AS version
    FROM (
        SELECT
            name AS table_name,
            CASE WHEN instr(name, '__v__') > 0
                 THEN substr(name, 1, instr(name, '__v__') - 1)
                 ELSE name
            END as name,
            CASE WHEN instr(name, '__v__') > 0
                 THEN substr(name, instr(name, '__v__') + 5)
                 ELSE ''
            END as version
        FROM sqlite_master
        WHERE type="table"
     ) AS amsdal_schema_registry
     WHERE 'amsdal_schema_registry'.'name' = ?
